origin.description: Drawing-bottom AO/wheelchair-marked exterior doorway in the east end vestibule.

alignment.method: Reference floor; native PDF coordinates, no inter-floor alignment yet.

metadata.coordinateConversion: x = (pdfX - 354) * 40/72; y = (681 - pdfY) * 40/72; rounded to two decimals.
metadata.loading: Initialize all nodes; expand each serialized edge both ways. Runtime distance is Euclidean distance between saved positions.
metadata.weightAssumptions: All weights are 1; distances omit stair rise, effort, elevator waiting time and courtyard slope.
metadata.accessibility: Only the two explicitly AO/wheelchair-marked end entrance edges are true. Lecture stair traversal is false. Other edges are unknown; no complete accessible route is established.
limitations: Manual doorway and circulation geometry from the dated floor plan; not surveyed or GPS aligned. Present door permissions and elevator operation are unknown.
Only floor 1 is digitized. No inter-floor connections or unshown campus paths are inferred.

User confirmed on 2026-10-19 that the stair rooms have walkable through paths. Connector landings and the north-east upper/lower approaches are joined by same-floor corridor edges. The approximate plan-view centerlines represent passage through the rooms, not stair traversal; accessibility is unknown.
Room 170 is a tiered lecture hall. Separate west and rear entry doorways are retained; no shortcuts through seating or speculative connection to the lower level labelled B/SEE SHEET 1 are added.
The elevator has a visible north-facing doorway. Its operating status and accessibility are not asserted.
Dotted divisions between 129/129B and 141B/141C are not used as unconfirmed passageways. Distinct shown entrances remain available.
Unnumbered rooms and custodial spaces use spatial names. Courtyard nodes are their shown doorway destinations; no path is added across a courtyard.

Rooms 101A/B/C are reached through the partitioned lower notch entered from room 111. The stub partition blocks a direct path from the upper 101 suite. Room 169 connects the north connector and room 165; rooms 165A and 135 have west-facing doors from 165.
Room 141 includes the open lower lobby serving 141A/C. The small bay west of 141A's side doorway is unnumbered; no invented room 139 is assigned.

stairRoomPassages.evidence: User confirmation on 2026-10-19: the landings are connected by a walkable path all the way through the rooms containing the stairs.
stairRoomPassages.geometry: Approximate plan-view centerlines through the north and south connector stair rooms and between the north-east approaches. Stair graphics do not establish a barrier to these user-confirmed passages.
stairRoomPassages.accessibility: Unknown; no accessibility flags are added to the corridor edges.
